issues.title: [TEST] Test only checks truthy value — no real assertion
issues.explanation: In /home/oguz/Masaüstü/TurPAN-Review-Agent/packages/analyzers/tests/fixtures/agent-output/__tests__/auth.test.ts line 7: This test evaluates only whether a value is truthy, without checking actual behavior, return values, side effects, or state changes. issues.suggestedFix: Add meaningful assertions that verify actual behavior. For UI tests: check rendered content. For API tests: verify response body and status code. For integration tests: use real sandboxes or test environments instead of mocking everything.
